items.title: Anthropic's GLM-5.3 Achieves Control Flow Hijacks
items.why: This highlights a concrete and concerning capability of advanced AI models in cybersecurity, demonstrating the urgent need for robust AI safety and security research in software engineering.

items.title: TypeSafe AI Debuts Jev: A New Category of 'Decision Models'
items.why: Introduces 'decision models' as a novel category of AI, offering a different architectural approach for tasks requiring structured decision-making, which could influence future AI system design.

items.title: Netflix Runs Full In-House LLM Serving Stack at Scale
items.why: Netflix's decision to manage the entire LLM serving stack in-house provides crucial insights into the complexities and benefits of full control over AI inference infrastructure at scale.

items.title: Cloudflare Python Workers Generally Available for Edge Compute
items.why: The general availability of Python on Cloudflare Workers expands options for serverless and edge computing, enabling Python developers to deploy code globally with low latency.

items.title: Coding Agents: Powerful, But Making Software Engineering Harder?
items.why: This offers a critical perspective on the real-world challenges and increased demands on discipline when integrating AI coding agents into engineering workflows.
